messages:
maria: incoming visitor at 3pm (UK partner) 1 bringing 3 boxes. can someone cover badging?
kevin: I can meet them at the lobby but the badge printer is acting up rn :/
sam (Front Desk): ops-bot reported a delivery at 14:58, boxes in the staging shelf #C. i can do checkin if we can get a spare badge printed.
maria: thanks sam. if printer is down, can we use a temporary paper badge and QR check-in?
ana: @sam there's a spare stack of adhesive name stickers in the supply closet. they work for quick badges.
kevin: perfect 1 i'll grab the stickers en route. who wants the comfy sofa by the windows? someone already claimed it? :eyes:
ana: dibs for 3:05 1 need it for quick call.
maria: can the guest wait in the small meeting room A until call ends? it's quieter and closer to the lobby.
sam (Front Desk): sure. guest will be given a temporary sticker badge and escorted to MRA. i'll leave a note on their package with the host name.
ops-bot: Delivery scanner: "3 packages" logged by courier "QuickShip". Locker available: false. Suggested action: label + hold at front desk.
kevin: heads-up 1 one box is fragile stickered. i'll bring the dolly.
maria: also need a visitor keycard (for 2nd-floor access). can security program a guest card quickly?
sam (Front Desk): security is on call 1 pinged them. ETA ~8 mins.
ana: poll for seating: windows sofa (maria 3:05), meeting room A (guest), overflow bench (kevin). react with :thumbsup: for bench, :heart: for bench + power outlet.
kevin: printer restart command i ran: ```sudo systemctl restart badge-printer && sleep 3 && lpstat -p badge-printer``` 1 shows printer is online but feeds jam sometimes.
sam (Front Desk): i cleared a jam, tested print, ok. printing 1 temporary badge now.
maria: greatly appreciated. will take guest down in 5.
ana: leaving a post-it on packages: "maria 1 guest, MRA, 3pm" so nothing gets mixed up.
kevin: dolly + fragile care engaged, moving boxes to front desk now.
ana: also FYI left a spare lanyard at the desk in case the clip on the sticker rips.
sam (Front Desk): guest checked in at 15:03, sticker badge applied, escorted to MRA. all packages logged and tagged. thanks team :party_parrot:
